reveal.headline: The evidence does not support the weekend's invention.
reveal.body: The provided sources contain no data on the historical invention or engineering of the weekend. The evidence is mixed and inconclusive.

explain.headline: Modern labor operates in new systems.
explain.body: Computerisation links to a new temporality. This works alongside clock time. The 24/7 economy drives the growth of nonstandard employment contracts.

matters.headline: Your schedule is being redesigned.
matters.body: That may be why your work feels less like a set of hours and more like a constant state of availability. The old structures are shifting.

stat.label: accuracy of conflict detection using intelligent systems

claims.text: Computerisation is linked to a new temporality that works simultaneously with clock time and perhaps presages the move from a disciplinary to control society.
claims.quote: It is shown how computerisation also ushers in a new temporality, which works simultaneously with clock time and perhaps presages the move from a disciplinary to control society.

claims.text: The use of an intelligent system for managing workplace conflicts improves conflict detection accuracy from 60% to 90%, reduces the number of reported conflicts by 30%, and increases employee satisfaction from 60% to 88%.
claims.quote: The results showed a significant improvement in conflict detection accuracy (from 60% to 90%), a 30% reduction in the number of reported conflicts, and an increase in employee satisfaction (from 60% to 88%).

claims.text: In the natural-system model, the goals of the organization are not paramount in determining the ordering and patterning of relations in the organization.
claims.quote: In the natural-system model the organization is regarded as a natural whole, or system. Although the goals of the organization are important, they are not paramount in determining the ordering and patterning of relations in the organization.

claims.text: The growth of nonstandard employment contracts is linked to the 24/7 economy.

claims.text: Industrial sociology is linked to the reporting of the news of industrial management and organization and of labor relations and conflict in a given series of industries in a given time and place.
claims.quote: A good deal of industrial sociology is a reporting of the news of industrial management and organization and of labor relations and conflict in a given series of industries in a given time and place.
